Checkpoint: dependency batches105–106 are published at https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/commit/a95e41a23ad9bbf6d25f5c7f544ed7ca7ea212ea . Both actual guards passed (585.561s and604.063s), with16 fresh modules3477–3492 and80 artifacts authenticated by the compiler owner. Detached guard OS-exit fields remain null; original042/057/059 outer outcomes remain UNKNOWN. The separate read-only metadata-command typo and correction are preserved; no compiler retry or limit change occurred.

The same commit preserves the reviewed, unexecuted0730 complete source-copy proposal: exact recovered consumer sources,0700 external wrapper and ten new generated fixture modules, with four same-byte duplicate modules retaining their original Lake owners. The1656-source union is a source inventory, not a compilation or mathematical-completion claim. The narrowed659-module wrapper remains the first admitted target after the required dependency and audit gates. The scoped G4 three-script static review is also preserved without adopting or compiling those scripts.

Publication readback verified45 owned text paths, five complete subtrees and15 individual Git-blob identities, while preserving five intervening peer commits/four peer paths. The first expected-head update was rejected after a peer advance; the same owned bytes were reconciled on the actual head and published non-force. Rust retains the sole serial compiler for107–108; live files are excluded. The independently reviewed0740 thirteen-header query proposal is queued for the next checkpoint and has not run.
